skill.summary: Amazon Chime API skill. Use when working with Amazon Chime for accounts, voice-connectors, voice-connector-groups. Covers 191 endpoints.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release with Amazon Chime API integration.

- Provides access to 191 Amazon Chime API endpoints across 25 groups.
- Supports AWS SigV4 authentication.
- Allows management of accounts, users, voice connectors, rooms, and bots.
- Requires an AMAZON_CHIME_API_KEY environment variable.
- Includes setup and usage instructions in the documentation.
